def run_jobs(cfg: Settings, names: List[str]) -> Report:
    """Run the named jobs in order and return the combined report."""
    rep = Report("Quanta suite (%s scale, seed %d)" % (cfg.scale.name, cfg.seed))
    for name in names:
        log.info("running job %s", name)
        JOBS[name](cfg, rep)
    return rep
